```markdown
# Claude Code context layout for atlas

| Location | Mechanism | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `/CLAUDE.md` | Root CLAUDE.md | Org-wide rules (commits, `make check`, trunk-based) apply everywhere, so they are always loaded; keep it short. |
| `/api/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | The `api/gen/` quirk matters only when working in Go, so it loads on demand instead of taxing every session. |
| `/web/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | The Playwright vs. unit-test distinction is relevant only to web work. |
| `/pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | The `AIRFLOW_HOME` requirement is relevant only to DAG work. |
| `/.claude/settings.json` (permissions deny/PreToolUse hook on `api/gen/**`) | Hook / permissions | Blocking edits to generated code should be deterministic, not a request Claude might forget. CLAUDE.md still explains why. |
| `incident-response` skill (`.claude/skills/incident-response/SKILL.md`, with the 20 steps in a referenced file) | Skill, ideally shipped via an org plugin | A long, repeated procedure that is identical for every team: it loads only when invoked, and a plugin keeps one copy across repos instead of drifting copies. |
| `warehouse` MCP server (`.mcp.json`, or the org plugin) | MCP | Live SQL is external data and tool access; use read-only credentials and a restricted role so analysts can query without write risk. |
| `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | User CLAUDE.md | Personal preferences stay out of the repo. |

## Deliberately left out
- The runbook in CLAUDE.md: 20 steps would be loaded every session for a rare task.
- Warehouse schema or SQL guidance in the root file: put it in the MCP server's tool descriptions, or in an analytics skill if it grows.
- Directory listings and tech-stack descriptions: Claude can read the repo.
```

## CLAUDE.md

```markdown
# atlas

Monorepo: `api/` (Go, gRPC), `web/` (React/TS), `pipeline/` (Python, Airflow).
Service-specific gotchas live in each directory's CLAUDE.md.

## Conventions
- Conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:` ...).
- `make check` must pass before opening any PR.
- Trunk-based development: short-lived branches off main, no long-lived branches.

## Gotchas
- Never hand-edit `api/gen/`; it is generated by `make proto` and edits are silently overwritten.
- `npm test` in `web/` opens real browsers; use `npm run test:unit` instead.
- Airflow DAGs fail to import unless `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` is set first.

## Other tooling
- Incident response: use the `incident-response` skill.
- Product metrics: query the warehouse through the `warehouse` MCP server.
```

Suggested nested files, each one or two lines:

- `api/CLAUDE.md`: "Everything under `api/gen/` is generated. Change the `.proto` and run `make proto`."
- `web/CLAUDE.md`: "Run `npm run test:unit`. `npm test` launches Playwright browsers; run it only when asked."
- `pipeline/CLAUDE.md`: "`export AIRFLOW_HOME=$(pwd)/pipeline/.airflow` before importing or testing DAGs."

I put the three gotchas in the root file as well so the guidance holds even before a nested file loads. Once the nested files are in place you can drop them from the root to save tokens. I can write all of these to disk if you'd like.
